# AgensGraph Code of Conduct

AgensGraph is developed in the open, and we want everyone who takes part to
feel welcome. This Code of Conduct applies to all project spaces: the GitHub
repository, issues, pull requests, discussions, and any other channel used to
work on the project. It also applies when someone represents the project in
public.

## Expected behavior

- Be respectful and considerate. Disagree with ideas, not with people.
- Give feedback that is constructive and specific, and accept feedback in the
  same spirit.
- Assume good intent. Ask before you conclude.
- Keep discussions focused on the project.

## Unacceptable behavior

- Harassment, intimidation, or discrimination of any kind.
- Insulting, derogatory, or demeaning comments, and personal or political
  attacks.
- Sexualized language or imagery, and unwelcome sexual attention.
- Publishing someone's private information without their permission.
- Any other conduct that would be inappropriate in a professional setting.

## Reporting

If you experience or witness behavior that violates this Code of Conduct,
email <inquiry@skaiworldwide.com> with "AgensGraph Code of Conduct" in the
subject line. Reports are handled confidentially. Please include what happened,
where it happened, and who was involved, so we can act on it.

## Enforcement

The maintainers are responsible for enforcing this Code of Conduct. They may
edit or remove comments, commits, issues, and other contributions that violate
it, and may warn, temporarily restrict, or permanently ban anyone whose
behavior violates it. Decisions are made by the maintainers at their
discretion, with the aim of keeping the project a safe and productive place to
work.
